summary: [Asana] webhooks: POST /webhooks per resource with filters (task.assignee changed, story.added comment, task.completed changed). Handshake = echo X-Hook-Secret. Deliveries signed X-Hook-Signature = HMAC-SHA256(raw body, stored secret), timing-safe compare. Tied to creating token: token deactivated -> webhook trashed. 1,000 webhooks/resource cap.
